events.title: Live Music with Jody Carroll
events.description:
Jody Carroll is an acclaimed, award winning blues and roots songwriter, master fingerstyle/slide guitarist  & visual artist whose performances blur the lines between tradition, storytelling, and improvisation. Drawing from the deep wells of blues, folk, mountain music, jazz, rock, and soul, Carroll creates a powerful and deeply personal musical experience that feels both timeless and entirely his own.

Genre: Blues, Americana

events.title: Line Dancing
events.description:
Join us for a fun and beginner-friendly line dancing class at the Stoller Wine Bar | Newberg! Led by the talented Kat Nichols, this 90-minute class will guide you through easy-to-follow steps, perfect for beginners or anyone looking to brush up on their moves. After the lesson, enjoy 30 minutes of open dance to practice what you’ve learned, sip on delicious wines, and have fun dancing the night away!

Tickets are $5 | Wine and food will be available for purchase

Please note that a small processing fee will be applied to event tickets at checkout

events.title: Live Music with Jacob Westfall
events.description:
Americana Tender-Rock Artist Jacob Westfall is a larger than life troubadour of love and adventure — a young veteran of the Portland music scene that has gained recognition as one of the fastest growing singer-songwriters in the Pacific Northwest; often seen onstage with a family of collaborators and musicians of his adoptive hometown community.

Genre: Americana, Folk Rock

events.title: Live Music with Timothy James
events.description:

Genre: Pop Rock

events.title: Live Music with King Louie & Sean Holmes
events.description:

events.title: Live Music with Renée Muzquiz
events.description:
Renée Muzquiz is a Portland singer-songwriter and guitarist creating “bleeding heart art pop,” blending nostalgic influences from the late ’60s through the ’90s with disco-funk, dirty pop, and heartfelt songwriting. A seasoned performer who has shared the stage with prominent Portland musicians, she currently lead sings and plays guitar in Major Tomboys, Portland’s all-femme David Bowie tribute band.

Genre: Art Pop / Alternative
